artist.name: Sadie Jean
artist.short_description: California singer-songwriter creating candid, relationship-focused pop about the uncertainty of growing up.
artist.biography: Sadie Jean is an American singer-songwriter raised in Orange County, California. She attended New York University, where she found collaborators who helped her begin recording and releasing original songs. Her breakout arrived with the independently released 'WYD Now?' in 2021, which gained wide attention through short-form video. She followed it with 'Locksmith' in 2022 and the 2023 EP 'Simple Like 17', establishing a catalogue centered on complicated relationships, nostalgia, and the particular intensity of young adulthood. Her full-length album 'Early Twenties Torture' arrived in October 2025. Speaking about that album, Jean said its earliest and latest compositions spanned her ages of 20 to 23, turning the project into a record of changing experiences and perspectives. She has also described how the writing moved from processing an earlier breakup toward meeting new people and navigating unfamiliar relationships. Afterglow approaches her work as confessional emotional pop: that classification is editorial, while the releases and autobiographical context are documented. Her material makes a natural companion to the relationship storytelling already represented by Sara Kays and Rosie Darling on the site.
